description: Fields scraped from the Command Code GOAT plan page (three HTML tables) and where they land in the snapshot. Only fields with a downstream consumer are stored.

models.<id>.cost.note: GOAT deal pricing; differs from any upstream cost in all_models.json. Omitted when every column is empty.

usage_quota.note: Monthly credits stored under the remark-consumed name usage_quota

models.<id>.{id,name}.note: id comes from the /models/<slug> anchor (dotted version restored, e.g. qwen3-8-27b -> qwen3.8-27b); name from the anchor text. Static fields (limit, modalities, ...) are NOT scraped here — they are fallback-merged from data/all_models.json.

not_collected.note: Intelligence column drives which models are kept (scored / inherited / default-50) but is not stored: no downstream consumer. Likewise the derived note.

drop_rule: GOAT-exclusive model ids with no bare-id record in data/all_models.json are dropped (no upstream base to merge).
